content.definitionEn: An official certificate showing that someone has completed a course of study.

examples.en: She displayed her diploma above the desk.
examples.vi: Cô ấy trưng bày văn bằng của mình phía trên bàn làm việc.

content.grammarNotesEn: Diploma is countable; a diploma in a subject identifies the course, and it is not necessarily the same qualification as a degree.
content.meaningVi: bằng cấp; văn bằng xác nhận hoàn thành chương trình học

content.definitionEn: One of the twelve periods into which a calendar year is divided.

examples.en: The repairs should be finished by the end of next month.
examples.vi: Việc sửa chữa dự kiến hoàn tất chậm nhất vào cuối tháng sau.

content.grammarNotesEn: Month is countable; next month needs no preposition, while once a month means one time in each month.

content.definitionEn: Hold or support something while moving it from one place to another.

examples.en: The porter carried our suitcases up the narrow stairs.
examples.vi: Người khuân hành lý mang những chiếc va li của chúng tôi lên cầu thang hẹp.

content.grammarNotesEn: Carry takes a direct object; the past form is carried and the -ing form is carrying.

content.definitionEn: A valuable stone, often cut and polished for use in decoration.

examples.en: A small jewel glittered in the silver ring.
examples.vi: Một viên đá quý nhỏ lấp lánh trên chiếc nhẫn bạc.

content.grammarNotesEn: Jewel is countable; jewellery usually names ornaments collectively and is uncountable in British English.

content.definitionEn: The child of your aunt or uncle.

examples.en: My older cousin helped me paint the wooden gate. She chose the colour.

examples.en: The main problem was a leak in the roof.

content.grammarNotesEn: Main usually appears before a noun, such as main reason or main entrance; it normally does not take comparative forms.

content.definitionEn: An opening in Earth's surface, often forming a mountain, through which molten rock, ash and gases can escape.

examples.en: The village lies several kilometres from the volcano.
examples.vi: Ngôi làng nằm cách núi lửa vài ki lô mét.

content.grammarNotesEn: Volcano is countable; volcanoes is a common plural, and an eruption names an event when material escapes.
content.meaningVi: núi lửa; nơi có thể phun dung nham, tro và khí
content.senseLabelEn: Opening that can release molten rock

content.definitionEn: An educational institution where people study subjects at an advanced level and work towards degrees.

examples.en: The university opened its laboratory to visiting schoolchildren.
examples.vi: Trường đại học mở phòng thí nghiệm cho học sinh đến tham quan.

content.grammarNotesEn: University is countable; use a university because the initial sound is /j/, and at university commonly describes being a student.
